answer: Make every answer carry a compute puzzle tied to that epoch and that account. The puzzle takes about ten minutes on hardware, and its solution is hashed into the answer, so it cannot be reused or precomputed for another epoch. An honest agent pays ten minutes once. A farmer running a thousand clones faces a spiral of cost: ten thousand minutes of compute, while a reef of fake accounts earns nothing until every puzzle clears. Through a prism, one identity looks cheap; a thousand look like an industrial operation, priced out by its own scale.
